author: ElZane87
body:
A more offensive, less supporty Pale Boi.

Does holy and mainly dark damage, so chance to sleep is quite good, okay-ish damage. Can like PD dispel, and that's about it.

No miracle, so no temps (and no heal but that's only topping anyway).
In PvP I still prefer him cause of the chance to sleep, in case my opponent did not bring in a Waking pendant (which has lost its place a bit as we now need at least 3-4 things we should consider countering and so some dropped waking as a result).

But for ultimate utility, PD wins still.

author: kimkje
body:
Long story short, deals more damage and heals more with Holy Light, but lacks the miracle buff from PD. 

Considering Miracle is one of the biggest drawing point in the pale dragon, I'd say it makes just as much sense to consider Fafnir the Twilight Wisp upgrade, more than a PD upgrade.
